key.name: enabled
key.description: Master switch to enable or disable automatic ambient color temperature matching.

key.name: temp-offset
key.description: Kelvin offset applied to the mapped screen color (+ for cooler/crisper white, - for warmer white).

key.name: display-min
key.description: Warmest allowable display color temperature in Kelvin to prevent oversaturation in warm indoor lighting.

key.name: display-max
key.description: Coolest allowable display color temperature in Kelvin (standard D65 white).

key.name: ambient-min
key.description: Minimum ambient Kelvin expected by the SmoothStep curve mapping.

key.name: ambient-max
key.description: Maximum ambient Kelvin expected by the SmoothStep curve mapping.

key.name: update-threshold
key.description: Minimum change in target Kelvin required to trigger a display update to avoid micro-flickering.

key.name: glitch-threshold
key.description: Minimum step change in ambient Kelvin to treat as a potential glitch requiring confirmation.

key.name: glitch-confirm-sec
key.description: Observation window in seconds to confirm large ambient color temperature jumps before applying.

key.name: min-lux-threshold
key.description: Illuminance in Lux below which sensor occlusion protection is triggered.

key.name: occlusion-hold-sec
key.description: Duration in seconds to hold the current white-point when the sensor is momentarily covered.

key.name: resume-delay-sec
key.description: Debounce delay in seconds after waking from sleep before re-synchronizing sensor readings.

key.name: enable-polling
key.description: Toggle periodic timer fallback in addition to interrupt-driven D-Bus events (off by default for pure event-driven efficiency).

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: Interval in seconds between periodic sensor checks if fallback polling is enabled.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Display an additional status icon in the top GNOME panel status area (off by default; toggle lives in Quick Settings).
